title: Meet Rosie, 5, who turned a princess scooter ride into a £4,000 fundraiser for her friend
summary_full: Empowered by compassion, five-year-old Rosie is taking on a four-mile scooter challenge in a princess dress to support her friend Sid's home adaptations. Incredibly, she has raised more than four thousand pounds to help Sid obtain necessary modifications, including a through-floor lift and accessible facilities. Sid's family expresses deep gratitude for Rosie's inspiring initiative and unwavering generosity during this crucial time.
